mapper.select: SELECT id,payment_id AS paymentId,merchant_id AS merchantId,merchant,rider,items,food_cents AS foodCents, delivery_cents AS deliveryCents,paid_cents AS paidCents,refunded_cents AS refundedCents, food_refunded_cents AS foodRefundedCents,payment_status AS paymentStatus,fulfill_status AS fulfillStatus, refund_status AS refundStatus,settlement_status AS settlementStatus,accepted,pending_refund AS pendingRefund, locking,payment_count AS paymentCount,paid_at AS paidAt,completed_at AS completedAt,closed_at AS closedAt, last_refund_at AS lastRefundAt,payment_last_refund_at AS paymentLastRefundAt,intervene, intervene_reason AS interveneReason FROM business_order ORDER BY paid_at DESC
SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(created_at,'+00:00','+08:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), ' · ',actor,' · ',note) FROM order_note WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(paid_cents),0) FROM business_order WHERE payment_status='支付成功'

SELECT id,order_id AS orderId,payment_id AS paymentId,reason,type,amount_cents AS amountCents, status,channel_status AS channelStatus,channel_reason AS channelReason,created_at AS createdAt, operator FROM refund_record ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id,applicant,applicant_type AS applicantType,amount_cents AS amountCents,status, created_at AS createdAt,reason FROM withdrawal_request ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id,name,type,balance_cents AS balanceCents,frozen_cents AS frozenCents,status FROM finance_account ORDER BY id

SELECT id,order_id AS orderId,subject,type,CONCAT('¥',FORMAT(food_cents/100,2)) AS foodAmount, CONCAT('¥',FORMAT(delivery_cents/100,2)) AS deliveryAmount,CONCAT('¥',FORMAT(paid_cents/100, 2)) AS paidAmount,CONCAT('¥',FORMAT(refund_cents/100,2)) AS refundAmount,settlement,created_at AS time FROM finance_ledger ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT j.id,j.account_id AS accountId,a.name,j.event_type AS eventType,j.reference_id AS referenceId, j.request_key AS requestKey,j.debt_id AS debtId,j.available_delta AS availableDelta,j.frozen_delta AS frozenDelta, j.created_at AS time FROM account_journal j JOIN finance_account a ON a.id=j.account_id ORDER BY j.id DESC

SELECT d.id,d.order_id AS orderId,d.merchant,d.rider,CONCAT('¥',FORMAT(d.rider_due_cents/100, 2)) AS riderDue,CONCAT('¥',FORMAT(COALESCE(a.balance_cents,d.merchant_balance_cents)/100, 2)) AS merchantBalance,CONCAT('¥',FORMAT(d.platform_advance_cents/100,2)) AS platformAdvance, CONCAT('¥',FORMAT(d.recovered_cents/100,2)) AS recovered,d.note FROM finance_debt d LEFT JOIN finance_account a ON a.id=d.merchant_account_id ORDER BY d.id

SELECT CONCAT('OPS-V',LPAD(id,3,'0')) AS version,fee_cents AS feeCents,food_rate AS foodRate, delivery_rate AS deliveryRate,regular_batch AS regularBatch,peak_batch AS peakBatch,service_start AS serviceStart, service_end AS serviceEnd,peak_start AS peakStart,peak_end AS peakEnd,accept_timeout AS acceptTimeout, reminder_interval AS reminderInterval,effective_at AS effectiveAt,operator FROM operations_config ORDER BY id DESC
